utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the thirteenth, then. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. I'm more distracted by the heating in the portakabin. July and it's like a greenhouse. Just having a moan, before anyone puts it on the list.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. We've accidentally made a drying oven with desks in it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the broken coffee machine in the canteen is still ruining my morning. That's also a moan, not me volunteering to mend it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You'd make it worse, Dave. We'd get hydraulic oil out of the hot chocolate button.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a catering meeting. Closed bits first, then what's actually being picked up.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, I signed off the inspection on the booster pump on Tuesday. That's finished, not something I'm carrying into today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, just so nobody hears that as tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah. Sorry, still got last week's dates in my head.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Same here. I signed off the inspection on the main isolation valve on Tuesday as well. That's closed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the Compressed Air Dryer on Tuesday. All done on that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. Those were showing in the previous notes, weren't they? Nice to have the distinction.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: While I've got the mic, I heard a slight rattle from the main water valve, nothing to action yet. Just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Similar from me: heard a slight rattle from the GT2 water valve, nothing to action yet. Not raising a job off that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Both observations, neither an action out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: The other carry-over is blocked. I can't get to the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Have they actually offered a window, or is it still the same position?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Still the same. No access window, so that isn't work I can take on today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, stays blocked. We're not pretending that's an agreed job for today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Where are we with the seals on the Water Booster Pump, then? Separate from that inspection, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. Signing off the inspection wasn't a seal replacement.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, I'll replace the seals on the Water Booster Pump today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, Saz, you've got that. I was mixing the two entries up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, the replacement's mine today. The completed inspection stays completed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you sort the training records for the new starters next Tuesday?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: The new starters specifically, not a trawl through everyone's older records?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, just the new starters. Next Tuesday for that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Nothing says welcome to the factory like a training record.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Better than welcoming them with whatever Dave's calling coffee.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you send the shift handover report round by the end of the week?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you there. That's the handover report itself, not another summary alongside it?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just the report itself. No second document.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. And we need the toolbox talk for the team organised.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team by Wednesday. Normal priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Dave. By Wednesday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep. Organising it, to be clear — I'm not saying the talk itself has to happen on Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the AC1? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, um, permit to work and isolation only — we're not rolling any physical repair into that?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Just the permit to work and isolation for the AC1.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Okay, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the AC1. Understood that it matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, that's the bit I needed straight. I heard AC1 and thought we'd jumped onto maintenance work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, nothing additional being assigned there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you do the pre-use checks on the FLTs this afternoon? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the pre-use checks on the FLTs this afternoon. Got the priority — not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, tiny bit of lag. You said pre-use checks this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's right. Pre-use, not a check after they've already been used.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: On purchasing, I'll chase the purchase order for the line two by end of day. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No rush, but still by end of day? Just checking I caught both bits.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, that's it. I'll chase it by end of day, just no rush ahead of everything else. That's a chase, not a promise the order will be approved.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood, Jamie. Chasing the purchase order for the line two, not guaranteeing approval.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I'll inspect the Boiler Safety Relief Valve for leaks by the end of the week. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's an inspection for leaks, yeah? Not taking the valve apart?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, inspection for leaks only. No strip-down included.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah Price. Boiler Safety Relief Valve inspection by the end of the week, then.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep. It matters but it's not urgent — keeping that separate from the FLTs this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Look at that, a whole meeting and I haven't acquired the coffee machine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I haven't acquired the heating. Strong start to a Monday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I was going to— sorry, no, that was your audio catching up. Thought someone was still talking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Teams doing its best. Right, that's the agreed work. The closed inspections aren't coming back onto the list, the rattles are observations, and the access issue stays blocked.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: All clear from me. Cheers, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks all, catch you on the floor.
